chunks: 4959 - Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام that Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said:
Indeed, the one characterized by doubt and disobedience is in the Fire; they are neither from us nor directed to us.

key_terms.إِلَيْنَا: to us; connected or ascribed to us
key_terms.الشَّكِّ: doubt; uncertainty in belief or conviction
key_terms.صَاحِبَ: one characterized by or attached to a quality
key_terms.مِنَّا: from us; belonging to the way and allegiance of the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a person who lives in doubt and disobedience?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns persistent doubt and disobedience, warning that such a person is destined for the Fire. It also declares dissociation from the path of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام for one who embodies these traits, highlighting the gravity of deviation in belief and conduct.
